article.title: Powerful, Brave, and Free w/Tamika Middleton
article.author: Scot Nakagawa
article.content: The far-right’s assault on democracy has always run through the bodies, agency, and political power of women. That’s not incidental, it’s structural. In this episode, Scot sits down with Tamika Middleton, Chief Strategy Officer of the Women’s March and co-founder of Kindred Southern Healing Justice Collective, to talk about what it means to organize at the intersection of mass action and healing… Source
